title: The Hill Street Delivery
kicker: GPT 独立第 1 组 · 第 2 篇
how: 同一组，换成送货场景。先不看中文读完；再遮住故事做回忆题，最后把其中一句换成你自己的经历。黄色词可点听有道发音。

paras.en: On Monday, Noah worked for a [[grocery store]] on Hill Street. He needed to [[deliver|/dɪˈlɪvə/]] food to Mrs Park, a [[regular|/ˈreɡjələ/]] customer, [[within|/wɪˈðɪn/]] an hour. She could not carry heavy bags herself. [[To help her]], Noah [[picked up]] two bags at the shop. They were [[already]] packed.
paras.cn: 周一，诺亚在山街的一家杂货店工作。他得在一小时内给常客帕克太太送去食物。她自己提不动重袋子。为了帮她，诺亚在店里取了两袋东西，袋子已经装好了。

paras.en: Outside, a van [[blocked|/blɒkt/]] the road. A [[crowd]] waited for the bus, and Noah did not want to be late. "I'm [[in a hurry]]. Is there another way?" he asked. A woman [[recommended]] a path behind the station. Noah checked the address on his phone [[to make sure]] he had the right house.
paras.cn: 外面，一辆货车堵住了路。一群人在等公交，诺亚不想迟到。他问：「我赶时间。还有别的路吗？」一位女士推荐了车站后面的小路。为了确认没走错地方，诺亚看了看手机里的地址。

paras.en: The path was [[not as busy as]] the main road. Noah walked fast and [[spotted]] Mrs Park at her door. He arrived [[in time]] for her lunch. "I really [[appreciate]] your help," she said. "Those bags were too heavy for me." Noah smiled. "I'm glad I got here."
paras.cn: 小路没有大马路那么忙，诺亚快步走，很快发现帕克太太站在门口。他及时赶上了她的午餐时间。「真谢谢你帮忙，」她说，「那些袋子对我来说太重了。」诺亚笑了：「幸好我赶到了。」

focus.core: 为了帮帕克太太，诺亚从店里取了两袋东西；目的和行动由同一个人完成。
forms: To help her, Noah picked up two bags at the shop.
To save money, she decided to make lunch herself.（第 1 篇）
focus.warn: 这里帮人和取货的是同一个人。

focus.core: 比较小路与大马路的繁忙程度。
forms: The path was not as busy as the main road.
The bread was not as expensive as the bread near the park.（第 1 篇）
focus.warn: 中间用 busy 原级，不用 busier。

focus.mean: 去取东西 / 送到某人手上
focus.core: 先在店里取两袋货，再送到帕克太太家；一取一送。
forms: Noah picked up two bags at the shop.
He needed to deliver food to Mrs Park.
focus.warn: 这里 pick up 是『取货』；第 1 篇 pick you up 是『开车接人』。

focus.core: 手机核对地址，送达不超过一小时。
forms: He checked the address to make sure he had the right house.
He needed to deliver food within an hour.
focus.warn: within an hour 是『一小时之内』，不是恰好在一小时整。

drills.cn: 为了帮她，诺亚在店里取了两袋东西。
drills.en: [[To help her]], Noah picked up two bags at the shop.

drills.cn: 小路没有大马路那么忙。
drills.en: The path was [[not as busy as]] the main road.

drills.cn: 他得在一小时内给帕克太太送去食物。
drills.en: He needed to deliver food to Mrs Park [[within an hour]].

drills.cn: 为了确认自己找对了房子，诺亚看了看地址。
drills.en: Noah checked the address [[to make sure]] he had the right house.

drills.cn: 他及时赶到，在午饭前把食材送给她。
drills.en: He arrived [[in time]] to bring her the groceries before lunch.

speak.q: 说一件你为了帮别人而做的事。
speak.a: To help my friend, I carried her bag.

speak.q: 说你上次在哪里取了一样东西，后来送到了哪里。
speak.a: I picked up a bag at the shop and delivered it to my friend.

speak.q: 说一次你用手机确认地址、时间或约定的经历。
speak.a: I checked my phone to make sure I had the right address.
